## Activity

During May 2023, Oakridge Primary Care completed 101 captures. Activity was delivered through the scheduled site programme, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity indicates that the site continued to provide the expected service during the month. No additional operational issues were identified in the information reviewed.

Of the completed captures, 1 was marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.0. The result should be considered when reviewing image acquisition and the practical arrangements supporting capture. The remaining captures were available for grading, allowing the service to proceed with assessment and reporting. Local teams should continue to follow established capture procedures and address any recurring issues through routine operational review.

## Grading

A total of 20 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 1 days. Grading activity therefore continued alongside the site’s planned operations, with the available results progressing through the assessment process. The referable findings should be managed in line with the relevant clinical pathway and existing local arrangements. Overall, the May 2023 activity shows continued delivery at Oakridge Primary Care, with limited ungradable activity and a recorded median grading wait of 1 days.
